thread:
incidents-bot: Pager triggered: inference-runtime-prod spike of 5xx/timeouts. Severity: P1. Affected service: infer-prod. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-134 

Tim_oncall: I'm on pager, joining bridge now. anyone see early cause?

customer-impact-bot: Summary: elevated 5xx rate peaked at 3.6% starting 00:12 UTC. ~14 customers with errors >1% in last 10m. Latency p95 increased from 420ms -> 1.8s.

eli_infra: seeing repeated segfaults in model-runner process on gpunode-12. excerpt from node syslog: ```
[2026-01-14T00:13:01Z] model-runner[2345]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f8b2a3f2a3f sp 00007ffebc1a8f60 error 4 in libinference.so+0x2a3f
Killed process 2345 (model-runner) total-vm: 14G
```
Also kernel dmesg shows OOM kill attempts for same PID.

maya_eng: possible regression from yesterday's quant-patch? but nodes show memory growth in the kvcache path. Can we fail traffic to smaller variant (small-quant) and enable fallback to dedicated pool?

tim_oncall: Initiating traffic reroute to smaller variant and enabling 503->dedicated fallback. Running: `infractl route set --service infer-prod --variant small-quant --percent 100 --from now`

eli_infra: cordoning + draining gpunode-12 now: `kubectl cordon gpunode-12` then `kubectl drain gpunode-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`. spinning replacement node. collecting core dump from /var/crash/* to s3.

maya_eng: also enabling aggressive prefix cache eviction to reduce KV growth: `service-config infer-runtime: kvcache.ttl=120 kvcache.max_entries=10000` (pushed to canary, then prod). dropping long-lived sessions.

sara_prod: Posting initial incident message to status page and CS slack, noting degraded availability for model-heavy requests. ETA for customer-visible mitigation ~20m.

tim_oncall: Observed metrics: error rate down from 3.6% -> 0.9% within 6 minutes of reroute. p95 latency back to ~480ms. Keeping bridge open for monitoring. :thumbsup:

ops_alert: autoscaler added 4 dedicated runners to absorb traffic. Fallback path trending stable.

tim_oncall: Next steps: keep routing to small-quant until runtime-sig confirms patch; gather core dumps + coredump logs, upload to INC ticket. handoff to daytime oncall @eli_infra at 00:45 UTC.

eli_infra: Ack, taking over monitoring and follow-up. Log bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-logs/incidents/1742109876/logs.tar.gz. Creating follow-up task for runtime team to investigate kvcache growth + recent quantization PR.

incidents-bot: Update: mitigation successful, status moved to "mitigated - monitoring". Pager closed and ownership handed to follow-up ticket INC-2026-134-FU. :white_check_mark:
